cases.description: A positive screen and a follow-up procedure during the visit: in the numerator under both
A positive screen and a referral authored during the visit: in the numerator under both
A negative screen: in the numerator under both
A positive screen and no follow-up: not in the numerator under both
A positive screen and a follow-up procedure three days after the visit: outside both windows
A positive screen on 20 February and a follow-up procedure on 19 February: before the screen, so outside v16's window too
A positive screen on 20 February and a follow-up procedure on 25 February, before the visit: v15 needs it during the visit, v16 from the screen
A positive screen and an antidepressant ordered the day after the visit, for March: CMS's draft requires the order to overlap the visit, v16 counts the order
A positive screen and an antidepressant ordered in December, active through June: CMS's draft times it by its order date, v16 counts it as active
Aged 13: a positive adolescent screen and an adolescent antidepressant active from December through June (the adolescent active-medication path)
A positive screen and a follow-up procedure with no performed time, recorded the day after the visit: v16 falls back to when it was recorded
A positive screen and active depression management with no performed time, recorded the day after the visit
Aged 13: a positive adolescent screen on 20 February and a follow-up procedure on 25 February, before the visit (v16's window)
Aged 13: a positive adolescent screen and a follow-up procedure with no performed time, recorded the day after the visit
Aged 17: a positive adult screen and an adult antidepressant active from December through June
Aged 17: a positive adolescent screen and an adolescent antidepressant active from December through June
A positive screen and a COMPLETED antidepressant order spanning the visit: an order, not an active medication (QI-Core's Medication, Active is status active)
A positive screen and an antidepressant PLANNED (intent plan) over the visit: not an order
A positive screen and an active antidepressant whose stated period ended in December, before the visit
